text.en: Clients repeatedly praise the gentle handling given to rescue dogs, senior pets, and naturally timid breeds. Reviewers mention that dogs with past grooming trauma or nervous temperaments leave the salon relaxed and happy rather than stressed. The groomers take time to comfort anxious pets, ensuring appointments feel calm and reassuring.

Pet owners report excellent styling results across various breeds, from long-haired sheepdogs to miniature schnauzers. Reviews highlight that coats look neat, smell wonderful, and remain easy to brush between appointments. Customers also value the efficient appointment turnaround, keeping dogs from spending unnecessary hours in the salon.

Reviewers describe Laura and the grooming team as friendly, helpful, and deeply dedicated to animal welfare. Multiple owners appreciate that the salon is flexible with appointment adjustments when pets are unwell. Clients note that staff listen attentively to specific grooming requests and treat each dog with genuine personal warmth.

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention booking their pet grooming sessions easily via the salon website.

q.en: How does the team handle nervous rescue dogs?

a.en: Reviewers specifically highlight the staff's gentle patience in reassuring anxious or traumatised dogs.

q.en: Are full grooming prices tiered by pet weight?

a.en: Yes, full grooming and bath packages are priced by dog weight categories published on their website.

q.en: Is appointment rescheduling flexible if a pet is sick?

a.en: Clients note that the salon team is accommodating and understanding when appointments need rescheduling.
